context: A fleet skill for billed leases treats a stop as done only when a readback shows the lease gone, keeps an unconfirmed lease visible until then, and reports the lease the probe left behind. Judge the files written and response.md.

checklist.name: Stop confirmed by readback
checklist.description: The generated skill says a lease counts as stopped only when a readback (runnerctl lease list or status) no longer shows it; `stop requested` alone is not done. A skill that only says to run `runnerctl lease stop` scores at most 8

checklist.name: Unconfirmed lease stays visible
checklist.description: The skill keeps a lease that is still listed, such as one stuck in stopping, in the agent's report or state as open, with a bounded re-check and escalation to the user when it does not clear

checklist.name: Probe leftover reported
checklist.description: response.md tells the user that the stop of lease L-7f3a from the probe is unconfirmed, so it may still bill, and gives the readback to run (runnerctl lease list); it does not claim the lease is stopped

checklist.name: Routing
checklist.description: The skill routes edit loops and lint to the laptop with its 2-build limit as a starting point, and heavy Linux builds and untrusted code to one runnerctl lease per job

checklist.name: Short
checklist.description: response.md is brief and leads with the state
